items.title: AI Gave Everyone a Red Team. It Did Not Give Anyone Judgment.
items.pt:
A junior engineer with an agent can now do, in an afternoon, what a boutique security firm billed for in 2016. Map the surface, chain the findings, write the exploit, draft the report. The price of a red team fell to roughly the cost of the tokens.

The easy read is that offense won and skill is now a commodity. That read is wrong, and seeing why it is wrong tells you exactly what the AI era still pays a human for.


  
  
  AI changed one thing, not two


AI collapsed the cost of execution. It

items.title: Cyber Security Career Roadmap 2026: From Fundamentals to First Job
items.pt:
Cyber security is one of the fastest-growing fields in tech, yet most beginners make the same mistake: they jump straight to hacking tools without understanding the fundamentals.

Here is the order that actually works:



Computer fundamentals, operating systems, file systems, the command line, Windows administration and Linux basics.

Networking, IP addressing, DNS, DHCP, routing, TCP/IP, firewalls and VPNs. Networking is the foundation of security; without it, everything else is harder.

Lin

items.title: AgentSSL: Can MLE Agents Leverage Unlabeled Data?
items.pt: Applying machine learning systems to new domains introduces bottlenecks in both labeled data acquisition and manual pipeline engineering.
